newsitem.title: USA: Banco Bilbao unit makes U.S. shelf filing.
newsitem.headline: Banco Bilbao unit makes U.S. shelf filing.

text.p: Bilbao Vizcaya International Ltd, a unit of Banco Bilbao Vizcaya SA, filed Wednesday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission a shelf registration to sell up to 40 million preference shares.
The non-cumulative guaranteed preference shares are worth up to US$1 billion.
The purpose of the share offering is to raise funds for general corporate purposes and to strengthen the capital base, the bank said in the filing.
As of December 31, 1996, the bank and its consolidated subsidiaries were one of the largest commercial banking groups in Spain based on assets and deposits.
